title: Binance Banking Triparty: Zero-Fee Until End of 2025
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance VIP & Institutional is excited to announce that all institutional users — new and existing — will enjoy a  full waiver of service fees  on pledged collateral assets for our off-exchange custody solution,  Binance Banking Triparty ,  until 2025-12-31. This promotion provides cost savings for current and new Banking Triparty users and institutions seeking secure, capital-efficient crypto exposure. What is Binance Banking Triparty Banking Triparty is a trusted custody framework designed for institutions, allowing clients to trade on Binance by pledging traditional fiat or fiat equivalent collateral such as yield-bearing Treasury Bills held off-exchange in their own corporate accounts at a regulated third-party custodian bank.  This allows institutions to earn yield on eligible assets while accessing Binance liquidity, enabling a capital-efficient strategy. By separating custody from execution, it reduces counterparty risk and aligns crypto activities with internal risk mandates, operational policies, and regulatory requirements.
